run_f_gold: run f_gold to count negative numbers in a row-wise and column-wise sorted matrix
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple matrix inputs to verify correct negative number counting
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use a different traversal strategy for counting negatives in a sorted matrix
review_f_gold: review f_gold staircase traversal algorithm that counts negatives in O(n+m) time
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which counts negative numbers in a sorted 2D matrix using two-pointer traversal
